current_worker_scope: Fable V1.4/V1.5; do not change the running assignment
near_term_target: V2.3 genuinely usable with all required earlier live checkpoints; V3 is separately gated
interpretation: Corrective delta, not 42 additional features. Refined semantics replace conflicting old task clauses. Reuse verified existing equivalents. Code surfaces and named tests are implementation targets, not a claim that these proposed files/tests already exist.

expected_output: Reviewed implementation or verified existing equivalent
Task-specific test results and exact code identity
Sanitized evidence satisfying this task's assertions
non_goals: Do not change Fable's running V1.4/V1.5 scope
Do not self-accept or perform unauthorized external actions
Do not rebuild equivalent accepted behavior

tasks.objective: Freeze one execution revision without overwriting the running worker.
implementation_steps: At the next safe handoff reconcile owner decisions, current branch and completed Fable artifacts. Record plan revision, base SHA, active worker/host/session, scope and heartbeat owner.

Use expected-base-SHA checks for shared writes. Preserve and reconcile concurrent changes; mark old conflicting queues reference-only. Review stale automated writers without changing running worker processes.
tasks.failure_behavior: COORDINATION_CONFLICT; block activation only, not running code.

tasks.objective: Resolve real commands and exact-head validation evidence.
implementation_steps: Resolve commands from current CLI help, package metadata, scripts and CI; label absent commands PLANNED rather than executable.
Record code/tree/dependency/schema identity, command, exit code and sanitized log hash. Include format checking; a skipped PostgreSQL/migration check is not PASS.
tasks.failure_behavior: VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE with the exact missing environment or command.

tasks.objective: Establish transport eligibility before implementation promises.
implementation_steps: Record provider, tenant, method, current primary-source policy, credential owner, available access and confirmation signal. Public job reads are not submit authority.
Select one eligible desired-job route for later exact approval, or record NO_ELIGIBLE_TRANSPORT. Do not extract employer keys, bypass controls or invent undocumented success routes.

tasks.objective: Create one consolidated input/access/authorization ledger.
implementation_steps: Inventory only authorized metadata for genuine resume mapping, machine, DB, browser, mailbox, historical evidence and targets.
Separate account creation, mailbox read, controlled test email, prefill, submit and spending grants. Preserve existing grants without broadening them; never assume an alias is a separate mailbox.
tasks.failure_behavior: BLOCKED_INPUT/AUTH/ACCESS per capability; no substitute resume or mailbox.

tasks.objective: Test real producers and consumers together, not handwritten matching rows.
implementation_steps: After Fable handoff execute actual importer, production builder, exporter and separate verifier against isolated engineering data; do not redo equivalent coverage Fable already supplied.
Run the canonical generation_origin and configured postgresql+psycopg path against real PostgreSQL; missing DB must fail. Clearly mark engineering fixture inputs as non-live.
tasks.failure_behavior: ENGINEERING_REWORK; fix incompatible contracts without weakening the verifier.

tasks.objective: Preserve tested-code identity after evidence commits change HEAD.
implementation_steps: Record source_commit, production-file tree digest, dependency digest, schema revision and run ID when code executes.
Store receipt/evidence commit separately. Accept reviewed content-equivalent code identity, not a blindly edited report SHA; material production changes require affected proof reruns.
tasks.failure_behavior: STALE_CODE_EVIDENCE; never rewrite runtime evidence to match HEAD.

tasks.objective: Classify evidence origin rather than trusting booleans or keyword absence.
implementation_steps: Require ENGINEERING_FIXTURE, REAL_PROVIDER_CANARY, REAL_CANDIDATE_WORKFLOW or REAL_HISTORICAL_RECRUITING with producer/source/run references.
Treat keyword scans and local hash agreement as secondary checks. Synthetic mail sent through real Gmail cannot prove genuine recruiting history or a desired-job submission.

tasks.objective: Independently recompute live campaign results from the declared source snapshot.
implementation_steps: Read authorized DB/source/artifact evidence and recompute counts, cohorts, packet/resume linkage, lifecycle membership and briefing digest.
Bind exact report bytes to a separate verifier receipt and require a nonempty expected capability/check set. Resolving IDs or arithmetically consistent rates is insufficient.
tasks.failure_behavior: CAMPAIGN_FAIL or EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE, never structural-only PASS.

tasks.objective: Generate the campaign schema through an actual runner, not a renamed briefing.
implementation_steps: Have the campaign runner call accepted services and emit the campaign envelope with a separately referenced CareerBriefing artifact.
Test actual documented commands in a clean install. Export a new allowlisted redacted artifact bound to local full evidence and verifier receipt; never hand-edit a proof report.

tasks.objective: Keep duplicate identity stable across profile edits and discovery sources.
implementation_steps: Persist candidate_subject_id independently of mutable profile/resume versions. Map an existing installation to its genuine stable subject once.

Use provider+employer/tenant+requisition identity with audited URL aliases. Exclude packet/profile version and mutable email from dedupe identity; preserve those snapshots in approval/evidence. Ambiguity goes to review.
tasks.failure_behavior: IDENTITY_NEEDS_REVIEW; no silent fuzzy consequential match.

tasks.objective: Maintain a durable logical submission claim across active and confirmed history.
implementation_steps: Uniquely claim candidate_subject_id plus canonical opportunity; append attempt rows beneath the logical intent.
Keep the claim occupied after CONFIRMED and uncertain dispatch. Active-only uniqueness is insufficient. A legitimate reapplication needs an explicit reviewed new intent, not a profile-hash change.

tasks.objective: Separate action kind, permission level and authenticated principal.
implementation_steps: Use action_kind such as SUBMIT_APPLICATION separately from permission_level such as P3; explicitly adapt older field names.
Derive principal/effective ceiling from trusted service or local authority, not request actor=USER or caller_ceiling=P3. Document the trusted boundary for fully privileged local processes.

tasks.objective: Enforce exact nonempty approval scope.
implementation_steps: Submit requires candidate subject, opportunity, packet/version/hash, all attached file digests, destination/method, current policy and active unexpired approval.
Reject empty target sets, missing hashes, substituted principals and revoked grants. P2 preparation needs scoped authority too; a caller boolean alone cannot widen it.
tasks.failure_behavior: REQUIRE_APPROVAL or DENY with stable specific reason.

tasks.objective: Reserve one-time approval atomically before dispatch.
implementation_steps: Bind and reserve approval for the unique attempt before network activity; only that attempt may use it.
Retain reservation after an uncertain outcome. Release only with evidence dispatch never occurred and policy permits retry; revocation prevents any new dispatch.

tasks.objective: Enforce service-level checks and close validate-then-mutate gaps.
implementation_steps: CLI, tools, browser and adapters use the same authoritative preflight. Non-exported Python handlers are not a security boundary.
Bind immutable upload bytes, form and destination to the manifest; immediately before writing recheck policy/approval/fingerprint/handles. A changed form, redirect or file reopens review.

tasks.objective: Persist intent before the network request; outer rollback must not erase it.
implementation_steps: Commit reserved attempt and dispatch intent before sending; persist outcome or uncertainty in a separate recoverable transaction.
Do not hold a DB transaction across network I/O. After timeout/crash reconcile external evidence, never blindly dispatch again.

tasks.objective: Derive confirmation from correlated external evidence.
implementation_steps: Validate source retrieval/reference, exact candidate/opportunity/attempt, observed time and provider-specific confirmation semantics.
Persist validator/version/evidence digest as output. Never trust caller-supplied independently_validated=True; generic thank-you page, HTTP 200 or unrelated confirmation is insufficient.

tasks.objective: Separate user-reported actions from externally confirmed submissions end to end.
implementation_steps: Store report time, claimed occurrence and externally_confirmed_at separately. A report emits no APPLICATION_SUBMITTED event.
After confirmation close only submission-satisfied tasks; display reported counts separately, exclude unconfirmed reports from confirmed rates and keep unknown historical resume attribution explicit.
tasks.failure_behavior: UNCONFIRMED or NEEDS_REVIEW, never inferred success.

tasks.objective: Make paged listing and per-message fetch one completeness contract.
implementation_steps: Follow nextPageToken within a fixed approved query/window and safety cap; persist run scope, listed/fetched counts and completion status.
On missing page/message, malformed token or cap mark incomplete and do not advance beyond unprocessed evidence. Bound retries and honor provider limits.

tasks.objective: Fix outbound direction and timestamp semantics.
implementation_steps: Use SENT labels and verified mailbox/alias identity, not hard-coded inbound; preserve ambiguity.
Store provider internalDate separately from RFC Date; use provider time for checkpoint safeguards. Parse headers case-insensitively and addresses structurally.

tasks.objective: Separate configured, connected and proven readiness without secret exposure.
implementation_steps: Check approved identity/scopes and a permitted harmless API call using supported parameters; report REAL only from observed runtime evidence, not a type literal.

Refresh tokens atomically with restrictive permissions and one lock; dashboard consumes sanitized cached health without token mounts or repeated provider refresh. Never initiate OAuth interactively in a diagnostic.

tasks.objective: Bind the actual ingestion command to the approved canary scope.
implementation_steps: Carry mailbox, query/label, time window, cap and read-only action grant into production ingestion; abort a broader effective scope.
Do not call unrestricted worker --once for a bounded canary. Keep synthetic provider test messages out of genuine recruiting analytics.

tasks.objective: Preserve original status and evidence on replay.
implementation_steps: A replay of PARTIAL remains PARTIAL with original warnings and review requirements; REPLAYED is metadata, not success.
Return the actual prior result or safe stored artifact reference. Never combine SUCCEEDED with an old partial result hash.
tasks.failure_behavior: REPLAY_EVIDENCE_MISSING or preserved original failure/review state.

tasks.objective: Namespace idempotency and reauthorize private cached results.
implementation_steps: Scope keys by principal, tool/version, effect and canonical payload; distinguish request ID from key and logical submission identity.
Check current read authority before replay. Revoked/expired action grants cannot redispatch; writes never refresh by repeating side effects.

tasks.objective: Use distinct local-write and external-effect transaction contracts.
implementation_steps: Commit P1 local effect and idempotent result atomically; a result storage failure must not cause another mutation.
Delegate P2/P3 to durable domain attempt services. Tool errors cannot erase external intent; mixed-section results preserve PARTIAL and unavailable sections.

tasks.objective: Freeze cohort, cutoff and confirmed-denominator definitions.
implementation_steps: Count unique externally confirmed logical applications; show attempts/user reports separately and freeze as_of/cohort window/observation cutoff.
Attribute immutable resume variants where actually known; show UNKNOWN otherwise. Replay cannot inflate stage counts. Label immature cohorts and low N.

tasks.objective: Keep strategy prospective, reversible and statistically honest.
implementation_steps: Require assignment recorded before application for experimental classification; experiment_id alone is insufficient.
No causal winner claim from sparse outcomes. Preserve treatment version and recommendation history; GATHER_MORE_DATA with evidence is valid.

tasks.objective: Preserve source/temporal identity through merges and confirmations.
implementation_steps: Separate inferred/asserted status from confidence; user-confirmed edges require authenticated principal, not a non-system actor string.
Preserve aliases, original links and immutable evidence through merge; recompute derived edges, invalidate stale/revoked sources and audit reversals. A relationship does not authorize outreach.

tasks.objective: Distinguish source failure from job closure.
implementation_steps: Closure evidence requires a complete validated successful source snapshot; 429, malformed/partial/failed response cannot close all jobs.
Use provider/tenant posting identity and preserve last successful snapshot/freshness. Track UNKNOWN separately; redirects and source URLs remain in approved destinations.

tasks.objective: Separate opportunity ranking from active-application actions.
implementation_steps: Rank unapplied opportunities separately from current applications, due follow-ups and unresolved reviews; do not exclude active applications before testing for FOLLOW_UP.
Use one as_of/profile/source snapshot. Reuse persisted score plus rationale or recompute both together, never old scores plus new reasons.
tasks.failure_behavior: Explicit data gaps/section unavailable, not an all-clear.

tasks.objective: Test actual operator decisions rather than only HTTP 200.
implementation_steps: Run actual browser against installed local production app: job rationale, packet, review resolution, timeline, follow-up, health, refresh and restart, using labelled engineering data first.
Retain loopback default, enforce write origin/authority and escape untrusted HTML. Restrict links and private data exposure; repeat the workflow later on authorized real data.
tasks.failure_behavior: UI_FLOW_FAILED; endpoint smoke alone is insufficient.

tasks.objective: Trace each interview claim to the right source and application-time candidate snapshot.
implementation_steps: Use exact application-time resume/profile, current interview state and dated job/company research; surface conflicts rather than blending versions.
Unsupported claims stay gaps. Cancellation/reschedule invalidates the brief; drafts are not sent. No interview evidence cannot count as an interview capability live proof.

tasks.objective: Validate schema/runtime on the real production database.
implementation_steps: Inspect live Alembic head before allocation; preserve reviewed submission-before-intelligence order without editing applied revisions or creating competing heads.
Run fresh install, nonempty upgrade, supported downgrade/re-upgrade, constraints and two-session races on PostgreSQL. SQLite is supplemental; missing PostgreSQL means validation blocked.

tasks.objective: Restore a coherent nonempty DB and referenced artifacts in a separate clean instance.
implementation_steps: Back up database, immutable artifacts, code/schema identity and manifest; verify checksums and never overwrite the live source for a drill.
Read back packet/resume bytes, source evidence, checkpoints and attempt claims after restore; restart without extra external dispatch.

tasks.objective: Exercise restart, bounded replay and failure recovery on the installed path.
implementation_steps: Run initial processing, idempotent replay, restart and another incremental cycle on the approved bounded dataset; fault-inject provider failure/recovery in engineering first.
Record start/end, scope, actual business progress and skipped/live checks. Heartbeat is not business progress; do not promise an unattended background run from a chat.

tasks.objective: Specify bounded durable tasks and specialist capabilities, not another domain DB.
implementation_steps: Specify task identity, parents, inputs/outputs, lease, limits, permission, budget and acceptance references.
Plan separate implementation artifacts; every specialist uses existing tools and emits a typed artifact. Task SUCCEEDED is not milestone COMPLETE.

tasks.objective: Specify a real credential/process authority boundary for autonomous tools.
implementation_steps: Reuse V1.6 approvals; agents receive allowed tools, no raw submit credentials or unrestricted DB writer.
Define cross-principal, revocation and direct-call tests. Document trusted-local-operator versus untrusted-agent threats; exports are not a sandbox.

tasks.objective: Specify scoped derived memory and source-driven invalidation.
implementation_steps: Memory holds references/checkpoints/derived summaries, not a replacement candidate profile. Include source versions, sensitivity and expiry.
Invalidate stale summaries after new evidence; memory and handoffs cannot grant authority or resolve unknown facts without evidence.

tasks.objective: Specify restart and bounded task scheduling without effect replay.
implementation_steps: Define an acyclic task plan with step/iteration/cost limits and explicit approval nodes; split router, leases and recovery into later separate implementation artifacts.
Recovery consults durable domain attempts; uncertain action means reconcile. Define loop detection and unchanged-work bounds.

tasks.objective: Specify measured model routing with non-negotiable safety evaluation.
implementation_steps: Reuse the gateway and actual available model IDs; lower-cost capable models handle bounded work. Record observed provider/model/budget.
Define success, missing-data, injection, denial, outage, retry and restart cases. Any new safety failure blocks promotion despite aggregate gains.

tasks.objective: Define a reusable specialist template, then separate each implementation artifact.
implementation_steps: Define one template with input/output, tool allowlist, ceiling and evaluation. Instantiate plans separately for Scout, Matcher, Resume, CRM, Interview and Analytics; do not implement all in this task.
Application, Networking and Brand external actions remain separately approved. Safety specialist advises, deterministic services enforce; no duplicated domain logic.

tasks.objective: Specify the real governed career-goal acceptance campaign.
implementation_steps: Define a real-data goal spanning multiple specialists, shared tools, traceable outputs, denials, budget and one restart; do not execute it under planning authority.
Require separately authorized external actions and independent live receipt. Historical genuine evidence may suffice where the capability allows it; fixtures remain engineering-only.
tasks.failure_behavior: LIVE_BLOCKED or LIVE_FAIL; no fixture-based completion.
